text:
dean: (async check-in) what I did: landed kv-prefetch throttling patch on canary, added a small throttling knob to avoid hotlooping during microburst
maya: nice. did you run the microburst harness against canary?
jules: ran one quick pass — seeing ~8% tail latency regression at 1.2k concurrent, digging into kernel scheduling contention
perf-bot: bench results: canary v1.14.3 -> baseline v1.14.1
  - p50: 11ms -> 10ms
  - p95: 120ms -> 110ms
  - p99: 340ms -> 310ms
  (full csv uploaded to S3: s3://redwood-bench/canary/2123456789.csv)
anika: blocker: the throttling knob defaults to 0.9 (fraction) which may affect small models — can we gate by model size? cc @dean
chris: quick note — eviction heatmap shows more churn for embeddings models when knob enabled, probably because KV eviction is now slightly more aggressive during bursts
dean: summary of planned follow-ups: 1) add model-size gating (small/medium/large) 2) add a safe default for dedicated customers 3) add a canary job that simulates embedding workloads
maya: tiny ask: I have a small PR that depends on the gating change (PR #4286). can someone give a quick review? @jules @anika
jules: I can take a look after the current repro, will try to review in ~30m :thumbsup:
anika: acknowledged, will double-check eviction interactions and leave comments on the PR. if we need a hotfix we can revert the throttle default
perf-bot: perf alert: canary run 2123456940 flagged p99 > 320ms for 3 runs in a row — tracking id BENCH-2123456940
dean: thanks. I'll open a short-lived feature flag so we can toggle throttle in prod canary if perf worsens. also posting a short playbook in #eng-runtime later today with steps to revert and collect traces
maya: I'll queue the PR for review and ping infra for an on-call slot if we need a rollback window later.
